rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A TypeScript-based MCP server that integrates WordPress with Claude and n8n via REST API, running on Cloudflare Workers infrastructure. Provides 24 tools for managing posts, pages, media, categories, tags, and comments. Supports multi-tenant authentication, external image hosting via NodeFlow, and headless WordPress implementations for automated content workflows.
